_comment: Documented first-occurrence / first-breeding years of the INTRODUCED eastern House Finch by state (BBS state-file stems). Compiled 2026-11-06 from quoted sources by a research agent; quotes and caveats in research/experiments/SANDBOX_INVASION_SHAPE_2026-11.md (ESTABLISHMENT-LAG LIT). occ 0 = first occurrence unverified (upper bound only). Veit & Lewis 1996 p. 266: 'a lag of 3-10 yr between the first record of occurrence ... in a state and the first recorded instance of breeding'.

NCaroli.source: Seriff 2018, Birds of the Central Carolinas

Indiana.source: Mumford & Keller 1984 via Cecil & Dinsmore 1995; Proc. Indiana Acad. Sci. 106 (1997)

Illinoi.source: Illinois Breeding Bird Atlas (Kleen et al. 2004) p. 392

Michiga.source: Granlund et al. 1994, Birds of Michigan (snippet)
